note: Real, hand-researched 'fun facts about the newest season' for the Discover page's 'My Next Watch' panel (Bill, 2026-09-15: 'these should be shows from my watchlist that recently wrapped up a season... don't show scores, just the image, the title and a couple fun facts from the newest season'). Same sourced-never-fabricated discipline as currentlyWatchingFeature.json's own facts array. WHICH 4 shows the panel features is live-computed every page load (see discover.js's pickNextWatch()/isRecentlyWrappedSeason()) — this file only supplies facts for whichever shows have actually been researched. A show the live selection picks with no entry here simply renders without a facts block (poster + title only) rather than blocking or fabricating anything, the same graceful-degradation precedent currentlyWatchingFeature.json's own facts field established. Re-research and add an entry here whenever the live top-4 selection shifts to a new, not-yet-covered show.

facts.text: Loosely inspired by the 1987 film Black Widow — but flips its premise. Where the movie shocked audiences with the idea that a woman might kill for money, Furious is about a female serial killer targeting powerful men tied to a web of abuse, told with real nuance about motive rather than shock value.

Created by Elizabeth Meriwether (New Girl), starring Emmy Rossum (Shameless) as the FBI agent chasing Lola Petticrew's calculating killer. All 8 episodes are out now — the finale aired August 31, 2026 — and Hulu renewed it for Season 2 within two weeks of the premiere.
Based on Elle Kennedy's best-selling college-hockey romance novels. All 8 episodes of Season 1 dropped on Prime Video the same day (May 13, 2026) rather than weekly.
Follows quiet, music-loving student Hannah Wells falling for hockey captain Garrett Graham at fictional Briar University — already renewed for a Season 2 with new cast additions.
A spinoff from the same creative team behind For All Mankind, set in the real, once-secret Soviet cosmonaut training city just outside Moscow during the Cold War space race.
Because so little about the real place was ever publicly documented, the show's creators had wide latitude to invent — the season finale aired July 10, 2026, with all 8 episodes now out.
A Legally Blonde prequel — set in 1995, following a teenage Elle Woods through the high-school friendships, forbidden romance, and fashion choices that shaped her before Harvard.

Produced by Reese Witherspoon's Hello Sunshine banner, with Lexi Minetree stepping into the role Witherspoon originated on film. All 8 episodes released the same day (July 1, 2026) — Season 2 isn't expected until mid-2027.

Season 4 adapts the 13th Reacher novel, "Gone Tomorrow" — moved from the book's New York setting to Philadelphia, where a chance subway encounter with a troubled woman pulls Reacher into a conspiracy involving a missing USB drive and enemies at the highest ranks of power.

Showrunners have called it the darkest, bloodiest season yet — trading the rural-noir feel of earlier seasons for a higher-stakes spy thriller. The finale (episode 8 of 8) airs September 16, 2026, and Prime Video renewed the show for Season 5 back in May.
